howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会解释 claude-mem 的工作方式:读取、编辑、执行命令都会变成压缩观察记录,会话结束时总结,相关记录自动注入后续对话;数据留在本机。
howto.when: 当用户说“claude-mem 怎么工作?”或“它在做什么?”时;记忆注入在项目第二次会话开始,首次会话先建立记忆。

say.note: 触发本技能,解释捕获和注入机制。

say.text: 数据存在哪?会传出这台电脑吗?
say.note: 说明存储位置和隐私边界。

say.text: 记忆什么时候会自动注入?
say.note: 说明第二次会话起的注入时机。

howto.what_en: Claude explains how claude-mem works: every Read, Edit, and Bash action becomes a compressed observation; observations are summarized at session end, and relevant ones are auto-injected into future prompts so the next session starts with context. Data stays in ~/.claude-mem.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks "how does claude-mem work?" or "what is this thing doing?". Memory injection starts on the second session in a project; the first session seeds memory.

say_en.note: Triggers the skill to explain capture and injection.

say_en.text: Where is the data stored? Does it leave this machine?
When does memory get injected automatically?
say_en.note: Explains injection from the second session onward.
